plain_description: Chatbox is your all-in-one AI copilot that brings ChatGPT, Claude, and other leading LLMs straight to your desktop. No complex setup needed — just download, configure your provider, and start chatting. Your data stays on your device, keeping every conversation private and secure.
technical_description: Chatbox is an Electron-based desktop application (TypeScript, React) that provides a unified client interface for multiple large language model providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini Pro, Ollama, and ChatGLM-6B. It features local-first data storage, streaming reply rendering, Markdown and LaTeX display with syntax highlighting, keyboard shortcuts, dark theme support, and internationalization across 10+ locales. The application is distributed as native desktop installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with companion iOS and Android mobile apps and a web version. The Community Edition is open-sourced under GPLv3 with code regularly synced from the proprietary Pro version.
title: Chatbox
